8935586.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of the forest into your home with this lifelike 6ft Christmas tree. It's a full-shaped seasonal spruce with classic Christmas colours and realistic foliage that sets the scene for all your festive celebrations. srkyqspq.baseName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
srkyqspq.variantName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
srkyqspq.sourceDescription: Enjoy a festive glow with the 8ft Pre-lit Slim Wildhorn Pine. This elegant artificial Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 470 multi-function warm white LED lights in a slender shape, making it a lovely choice for rooms with higher ceilings where floor space is limited. Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Slim Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. It offers a beautifully full look within a narrow silhouette. It has gently upswept branches and a slim, tapered shape, with natural green shades and subtle brown detailing. At 8ft tall, it brings impressive height to your festive display while leaving more room for your Christmas celebrations. Warm white LEDs highlight the needles, with multiple lighting effects to suit your display. The tree comes in three sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. Spread inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
